q: 妈妈___做饭，你先看电视吧。
zh: 妈妈在做饭，你先看电视吧。
py: mā ma zài zuò fàn nǐ xiān kàn diàn shì ba
en: Mum is cooking, so watch TV for now.
why: 在 goes right before the verb to say the cooking is under way. 是 is not the 'is' of 'is cooking', and 有 or 把 cannot sit in front of 做饭 like this.

q: 爸爸现在___看报纸。
zh: 爸爸现在在看报纸。
py: bà ba xiàn zài zài kàn bào zhǐ
en: Dad is reading the newspaper now.
why: 现在 comes first, then 在 directly before the verb. 是 only copies English 'is', and 很 cannot modify an action like 看报纸.

q: 哥哥也___洗车。
zh: 哥哥也在洗车。
py: gē ge yě zài xǐ chē
en: My older brother is washing the car too.
why: 也 comes before 在, and 在 comes before the verb 洗车. 了 would sit after a verb, not in front of one.

q: 他们都___准备搬家。
zh: 他们都在准备搬家。
py: tā men dōu zài zhǔn bèi bān jiā
en: They are all getting ready to move house.
why: 都 goes before 在, and 在 stands right before the verb 准备 to show the preparing is in progress. 把, 有 and 到 do not form a progressive.

q: 我弟弟正___写作业，别吵他。
zh: 我弟弟正在写作业，别吵他。
py: wǒ dì di zhèng zài xiě zuò yè bié chǎo tā
en: My younger brother is doing his homework, don't bother him.
why: 正 needs 在 to make 正在 before the verb. 正是, 正有 and 正着 are not a progressive marker.

q: 路上很堵，司机们都___按喇叭。
zh: 路上很堵，司机们都在按喇叭。
py: lù shang hěn dǔ sī jī men dōu zài àn lǎ ba
en: The road is jammed and the drivers are all honking their horns.
why: 都 then 在 then the verb: the honking is happening right now. 是, 把 and 给 cannot introduce 按喇叭 as an action in progress.

q: 我听见楼上的邻居___搬家具，吵得我睡不着。
zh: 我听见楼上的邻居在搬家具，吵得我睡不着。
py: wǒ tīng jiàn lóu shàng de lín jū zài bān jiā jù chǎo de wǒ shuì bù zháo
en: I can hear the upstairs neighbour moving furniture, and the noise keeps me awake.
why: 在 before 搬家具 shows the moving is going on while I listen. 是, 有 and 被 do not mark a happening action here, and 被 would need the furniture as subject.

q: 我们俩都___等对方先开口，所以谁也没说话。
zh: 我们俩都在等对方先开口，所以谁也没说话。
py: wǒ men liǎ dōu zài děng duì fāng xiān kāi kǒu suǒ yǐ shéi yě méi shuō huà
en: We were both waiting for the other to speak first, so neither of us said anything.
why: 都 then 在 then 等: both were in the middle of waiting. 有, 把 and 被 cannot stand before a plain verb to say this.

q: 你小声点，宝宝睡觉___。
zh: 你小声点，宝宝睡觉呢。
py: nǐ xiǎo shēng diǎn bǎo bao shuì jiào ne
en: Keep it down, the baby is sleeping.
why: Sentence-final 呢 marks a statement as 'going on right now'. 吗 turns it into a question and 吧 into a suggestion or guess; 的 does not complete it.

q: 别关电视，爸爸看新闻___。
zh: 别关电视，爸爸看新闻呢。
py: bié guān diàn shì bà ba kàn xīn wén ne
en: Don't turn off the TV, Dad is watching the news.
why: 呢 at the end shows Dad is in the middle of watching. 过 would mean he has watched it before, and 吗 would ask a question.

q: 妹妹在厨房洗菜___。
zh: 妹妹在厨房洗菜呢。
py: mèi mei zài chú fáng xǐ cài ne
en: My younger sister is washing vegetables in the kitchen.
why: The statement of an ongoing action ends in 呢. 吗 would make it a question, and 过 after the object is not possible.

q: 你先别进去，他们正在开会___。
zh: 你先别进去，他们正在开会呢。
py: nǐ xiān bié jìn qù tā men zhèng zài kāi huì ne
en: Don't go in yet, they're in a meeting right now.
why: 正在 and final 呢 happily go together to stress it is under way. 了 clashes with 正在, 吗 makes a question, and 过 does not end a sentence.

q: 等一下，我正在找钥匙___，马上就好。
zh: 等一下，我正在找钥匙呢，马上就好。
py: děng yī xià wǒ zhèng zài zhǎo yào shi ne mǎ shàng jiù hǎo
en: Hang on, I'm looking for my keys, it'll be a moment.
why: 呢 closes the clause to say the search is still going on. 吗 would ask a question, and 了 would suggest the search is over, which contradicts 马上就好.

q: 孩子们还在楼下玩___，还没回来。
zh: 孩子们还在楼下玩呢，还没回来。
py: hái zi men hái zài lóu xià wán ne hái méi huí lái
en: The kids are still playing downstairs, they haven't come back.
why: 还在 plus final 呢 describes what is still going on. 了 would say the playing is over, which clashes with 还没回来, and 吗 is a question marker.

q: 你不用打电话了，奶奶和爷爷正在公园里散步___，晚点儿就回来。
zh: 你不用打电话了，奶奶和爷爷正在公园里散步呢，晚点儿就回来。
py: nǐ bù yòng dǎ diàn huà le nǎi nai hé yé ye zhèng zài gōng yuán lǐ sàn bù ne wǎn diǎn r jiù huí lái
en: No need to call, Grandma and Grandpa are out for a walk in the park, they'll be back later.
why: 呢 at the end of the first clause says the walk is going on. 吗 would ask a question, 过 cannot end a clause, and 的 does not fit.

q: 我___在看电视，我在看书。
zh: 我没在看电视，我在看书。
py: wǒ méi zài kàn diàn shì wǒ zài kàn shū
en: I'm not watching TV, I'm reading.
why: An action in progress is negated with 没 before 在. 没正 and 不正 do not exist because 正 drops out, and 别 is an order, not a statement.

q: 弟弟___在睡觉，他在玩游戏。
zh: 弟弟没在睡觉，他在玩游戏。
py: dì di méi zài shuì jiào tā zài wán yóu xì
en: My younger brother isn't sleeping, he's playing a game.
why: 没 plus 在 denies the in-progress action. 不正在 and 没正在 are never said, and 别 is a command.

q: 你在做饭吗？___，我在洗衣服。
zh: 你在做饭吗？没有，我在洗衣服。
py: nǐ zài zuò fàn ma méi yǒu wǒ zài xǐ yī fu
en: Are you cooking? No, I'm washing clothes.
why: The short answer to a 在-question is 没有. 不正在 and 没正在 are not real forms because 正 disappears in the negative.

q: 爸爸___在客厅看电视，他在书房工作。
zh: 爸爸没在客厅看电视，他在书房工作。
py: bà ba méi zài kè tīng kàn diàn shì tā zài shū fáng gōng zuò
en: Dad isn't watching TV in the living room, he's working in the study.
why: Denying an activity that would be happening uses 没 before 在. 不正 and 没正 do not exist, and 别 is an imperative.

q: 我们___在排队买票，我们刚到。
zh: 我们没在排队买票，我们刚到。
py: wǒ men méi zài pái duì mǎi piào wǒ men gāng dào
en: We aren't queuing for tickets, we've just arrived.
why: 没 + 在 negates the in-progress action. Once negated, 正 cannot stay, so 没正 and 不正 fail, and 别 is a command.

q: 你是不是在玩手机？___，我在查地图。
zh: 你是不是在玩手机？没有，我在查地图。
py: nǐ shì bu shì zài wán shǒu jī méi yǒu wǒ zài chá dì tú
en: Are you playing on your phone? No, I'm checking the map.
why: 没有 is the clean denial of an in-progress action. 不正在 and 没正在 mix 正 with a negative, which Chinese never does.

q: 你别以为我在偷懒，我___在休息，我在想怎么修这台洗衣机。
zh: 你别以为我在偷懒，我没在休息，我在想怎么修这台洗衣机。
py: nǐ bié yǐ wéi wǒ zài tōu lǎn wǒ méi zài xiū xi wǒ zài xiǎng zěn me xiū zhè tái xǐ yī jī
en: Don't think I'm slacking off, I'm not resting, I'm thinking about how to fix this washing machine.
why: To deny 在休息 you say 没在休息. 不正 and 没正 are not forms, and 别 would turn the clause into a command to yourself.

q: 昨天你打电话的时候，我___洗澡。
zh: 昨天你打电话的时候，我正在洗澡。
py: zuó tiān nǐ dǎ diàn huà de shí hou wǒ zhèng zài xǐ zǎo
en: When you called yesterday, I was in the shower.
why: The shower was in progress at a past moment, so 正在 goes before the verb, with no tense change. 了 and 过 cannot stand before 洗澡 and would not say 'was in the middle of'.

q: 昨天晚上八点，妈妈___做饭。
zh: 昨天晚上八点，妈妈在做饭。
py: zuó tiān wǎn shang bā diǎn mā ma zài zuò fàn
en: At eight last night Mum was cooking.
why: 在 works for a past moment fixed by 昨天晚上八点. 了 and 过 before the verb are impossible, and 是 is not 'was' here.

q: 明天晚上七点我___开会，不能接电话。
zh: 明天晚上七点我在开会，不能接电话。
py: míng tiān wǎn shang qī diǎn wǒ zài kāi huì bù néng jiē diàn huà
en: I'll be in a meeting at seven tomorrow evening, so I can't answer the phone.
why: 在 has no tense, so it also covers a future moment set by 明天晚上七点. 把, 是 and 了 cannot precede 开会 to give 'will be in the middle of'.

q: 我给你打电话的时候，你___在做什么？
zh: 我给你打电话的时候，你正在做什么？
py: wǒ gěi nǐ dǎ diàn huà de shí hou nǐ zhèng zài zuò shén me
en: What were you doing when I called you?
why: 'What were you in the middle of?' is 正在 with the unchanged verb. 了 and 过 cannot be placed before 在, and 有在 is not a pattern.

q: 地铁到站的时候，很多人___站台上等车。
zh: 地铁到站的时候，很多人正在站台上等车。
py: dì tiě dào zhàn de shí hou hěn duō rén zhèng zài zhàn tái shàng děng chē
en: When the train pulled in, a lot of people were waiting on the platform.
why: 正在 + place + verb says what was under way at the moment of arrival. 了, 过 and 着 cannot take the place of the 在 that introduces 站台上.

q: 昨天警察来的时候，邻居们都___院子里聊天。
zh: 昨天警察来的时候，邻居们都正在院子里聊天。
py: zuó tiān jǐng chá lái de shí hou lín jū men dōu zhèng zài yuàn zi lǐ liáo tiān
en: When the police came yesterday, the neighbours were all chatting in the yard.
why: The chatting was in progress when the police arrived, so 正在 before the place. 了, 过 and 着 cannot stand there and would not give the 'was in the middle of' reading.

q: 我们昨天到的时候，他们已经___吃饭了，所以我们没打扰他们。
zh: 我们昨天到的时候，他们已经在吃饭了，所以我们没打扰他们。
py: wǒ men zuó tiān dào de shí hou tā men yǐ jīng zài chī fàn le suǒ yǐ wǒ men méi dǎ rǎo tā men
en: When we arrived yesterday they were already eating, so we didn't disturb them.
why: 已经在 + verb + 了 means 'was already at it'. 了, 过 and 是 cannot stand between 已经 and the verb to say that.

q: 奶奶一直___等你，快去看看她吧。
zh: 奶奶一直在等你，快去看看她吧。
py: nǎi nai yī zhí zài děng nǐ kuài qù kàn kan tā ba
en: Grandma has been waiting for you all along, go and see her.
why: 一直 stretches the waiting over a period, so plain 在 is used. 正在 pins one exact moment and clashes with 一直.

q: 已经十点了，哥哥还___睡觉。
zh: 已经十点了，哥哥还在睡觉。
py: yǐ jīng shí diǎn le gē ge hái zài shuì jiào
en: It's already ten and my older brother is still sleeping.
why: 还 means the sleeping continues, so plain 在 follows it. 还正在 is not said, and 了 or 是 cannot follow 还 here.

q: 我妹妹总是___玩手机，不爱看书。
zh: 我妹妹总是在玩手机，不爱看书。
py: wǒ mèi mei zǒng shì zài wán shǒu jī bù ài kàn shū
en: My younger sister is always on her phone and doesn't like reading.
why: 总是 describes a repeated habit, so plain 在. 正在 means one exact moment and cannot go with 总是.

q: 爷爷每天早上都___打太极拳。
zh: 爷爷每天早上都在打太极拳。
py: yé ye měi tiān zǎo shang dōu zài dǎ tài jí quán
en: Grandpa does tai chi every morning.
why: 每天 makes it a repeated activity, so plain 在 is right. 正在 is for a single moment, and 过 or 着 cannot stand before 打.

q: 你怎么还___睡？太阳都出来了。
zh: 你怎么还在睡？太阳都出来了。
py: nǐ zěn me hái zài shuì tài yáng dōu chū lái le
en: How come you're still asleep? The sun is already up.
why: 还 + 在 says the sleeping is still going on. 还正在 is not said, and 是 or 有 cannot follow 还 to express 'still asleep'.

q: 他经常___想回老家，因为他很想念父母。
zh: 他经常在想回老家，因为他很想念父母。
py: tā jīng cháng zài xiǎng huí lǎo jiā yīn wèi tā hěn xiǎng niàn fù mǔ
en: He often finds himself thinking about going back to his hometown, because he misses his parents.
why: 经常 describes something that keeps happening, so plain 在. 正在 is for one moment only, and 了 or 过 cannot stand before 想.

q: 我从早上到现在一直___找那家饭馆，可是还没找到。
zh: 我从早上到现在一直在找那家饭馆，可是还没找到。
py: wǒ cóng zǎo shang dào xiàn zài yī zhí zài zhǎo nà jiā fàn guǎn kě shì hái méi zhǎo dào
en: I've been looking for that restaurant from the morning until now, and I still haven't found it.
why: 一直 plus a long span means a continuing activity, so plain 在. 正在 pins a single moment, and 了 or 过 cannot follow 一直 directly.

q: 妈妈不___家，她去超市了。
zh: 妈妈不在家，她去超市了。
py: mā ma bù zài jiā tā qù chāo shì le
en: Mum isn't at home, she's gone to the supermarket.
why: 在 + place alone means 'be at', negated with 不 before 在. 不是家, 不有家 and 不去家 do not say 'not at home'.

q: 奶奶___公园里散步。
zh: 奶奶在公园里散步。
py: nǎi nai zài gōng yuán lǐ sàn bù
en: Grandma is walking in the park.
why: 在 + place + verb says where the action happens, and the place goes before the verb. 是, 有 and 给 cannot introduce 公园里.

q: 我哥哥___图书馆学习。
zh: 我哥哥在图书馆学习。
py: wǒ gē ge zài tú shū guǎn xué xí
en: My older brother is studying in the library.
why: 在 introduces the location before the verb 学习. 对, 是 and 有 do not introduce a place of action.

q: 李老师___在办公室，你去楼下的教室找她。
zh: 李老师不在办公室，你去楼下的教室找她。
py: lǐ lǎo shī bù zài bàn gōng shì nǐ qù lóu xià de jiào shì zhǎo tā
en: Teacher Li isn't in the office, go and look for her in the classroom downstairs.
why: 在 as a main verb ('be at') is negated by 不. 很 and 别 do not negate 在, and 还 would say she is still there, which contradicts the second clause.

q: 他___教室里等你，你快去吧。
zh: 他正在教室里等你，你快去吧。
py: tā zhèng zài jiào shì lǐ děng nǐ nǐ kuài qù ba
en: He's waiting for you in the classroom right now, so hurry.
why: One 在 does both jobs, 'in the classroom' and 'in progress', so it is 正在 and never a doubled 在. 正在在, 在在 and 有在 are all unusable.

q: 孩子们都___小区的花园里踢球，只有小王一个人在家写作业。
zh: 孩子们都在小区的花园里踢球，只有小王一个人在家写作业。
py: hái zi men dōu zài xiǎo qū de huā yuán lǐ tī qiú zhǐ yǒu xiǎo wáng yī ge rén zài jiā xiě zuò yè
en: The kids are all playing football in the neighbourhood garden, only Xiao Wang is at home doing homework.
why: 在 + place before the verb gives where the kicking happens. 对, 是 and 有 cannot introduce 小区的花园里 as a location.

q: 我昨天到家的时候，爸爸不___家，他在楼下的超市买东西。
zh: 我昨天到家的时候，爸爸不在家，他在楼下的超市买东西。
py: wǒ zuó tiān dào jiā de shí hou bà ba bù zài jiā tā zài lóu xià de chāo shì mǎi dōng xi
en: When I got home yesterday Dad wasn't there, he was at the supermarket downstairs buying things.
why: 不在家 is the main-verb 在, 'not be at home', with 不. 不是家, 不有家 and 不会家 cannot mean this.

q: 我___知道他的电话号码。
zh: 我知道他的电话号码。
py: wǒ zhī dào tā de diàn huà hào mǎ
en: I know his phone number.
why: 知道 is a state, not an activity in progress, so no 在 or 正在 goes before it. Leave the blank empty.

q: 弟弟___喜欢这只小猫。
zh: 弟弟喜欢这只小猫。
py: dì di xǐ huan zhè zhī xiǎo māo
en: My younger brother likes this kitten.
why: 喜欢 is a feeling, not an action under way, so it takes neither 在 nor 正在. English 'is liking' does not carry over.

q: 我们家___有三个房间。
zh: 我们家有三个房间。
py: wǒ men jiā yǒu sān ge fáng jiān
en: Our home has three rooms.
why: 有 is a state and never takes 在 or 正在. The blank must stay empty.

q: 他现在___是我们班的班长。
zh: 他现在是我们班的班长。
py: tā xiàn zài shì wǒ men bān de bān zhǎng
en: He is our class monitor now.
why: 是 is not an action, so 在 and 正在 cannot go before it even with 现在. The time word alone says 'now'.

q: 我___觉得这个房子太小了，不太适合我们住。
zh: 我觉得这个房子太小了，不太适合我们住。
py: wǒ jué de zhè ge fáng zi tài xiǎo le bù tài shì hé wǒ men zhù
en: I think this flat is too small and doesn't really suit us.
why: 觉得 reports an opinion, a state, so no 在 or 正在 despite English 'I'm thinking'. Leave the blank empty.

q: 我不___知道楼下新搬来的邻居是做什么工作的，只听说他很有钱。
zh: 我不知道楼下新搬来的邻居是做什么工作的，只听说他很有钱。
py: wǒ bù zhī dào lóu xià xīn bān lái de lín jū shì zuò shén me gōng zuò de zhǐ tīng shuō tā hěn yǒu qián
en: I don't know what the new neighbour downstairs does for a living, I only heard he is rich.
why: 知道 is a state and never takes 在, not even when negated. So 不 sits directly against 知道.

q: 我正在写___作业，别跟我说话。
zh: 我正在写作业，别跟我说话。
py: wǒ zhèng zài xiě zuò yè bié gēn wǒ shuō huà
en: I'm doing my homework, don't talk to me.
why: After 正在 the verb stays bare. 了 would say the writing is done, 过 would mean experience, and both clash with 别跟我说话.

q: 爸爸在洗___碗，你去帮他吧。
zh: 爸爸在洗碗，你去帮他吧。
py: bà ba zài xǐ wǎn nǐ qù bāng tā ba
en: Dad is washing the dishes, go and help him.
why: The verb after 在 is bare. 了 or the result 完 would say the washing is finished, which contradicts 帮他.

q: 我在看___一部电影，你别关电视。
zh: 我在看一部电影，你别关电视。
py: wǒ zài kàn yī bù diàn yǐng nǐ bié guān diàn shì
en: I'm watching a film, don't turn off the TV.
why: In progress means not complete, so the verb takes no 了 or 过. 看了 would suggest the film is already watched and 看过 that I have seen it before.

q: 孩子们正在做___作业，还没做完。
zh: 孩子们正在做作业，还没做完。
py: hái zi men zhèng zài zuò zuò yè hái méi zuò wán
en: The kids are doing their homework and haven't finished yet.
why: After 正在 the verb stays bare. 做完 or 做了 would say the homework is finished, and 还没做完 states it is not.

q: 我等___你一个小时了，你怎么才来？
zh: 我等了你一个小时了，你怎么才来？
py: wǒ děng le nǐ yī ge xiǎo shí le nǐ zěn me cái lái
en: I've been waiting for you for an hour, why are you only just here?
why: 'Have been doing for an hour' is verb + 了 + duration + 了, never 在 plus a duration. 等在你 and 等过你 do not give 'have been waiting'.

q: 他陪奶奶在医院住___三天了，现在还没回家。
zh: 他陪奶奶在医院住了三天了，现在还没回家。
py: tā péi nǎi nai zài yī yuàn zhù le sān tiān le xiàn zài hái méi huí jiā
en: He has been staying at the hospital with Grandma for three days and still hasn't come home.
why: A duration that is still running uses 了 after the verb plus a final 了. 住着三天 and 住在三天 are not possible with a duration.

zh: 我们都在打扫房间。
py: wǒ men dōu zài dǎ sǎo fáng jiān
en: We are all cleaning the room.
why: 都 comes before 在, and 在 comes right before the verb. 在 cannot come before the subject or after the verb.

zh: 哥哥正在洗车。
py: gē ge zhèng zài xǐ chē
en: My older brother is washing the car right now.
why: The subject comes first, then 正在, then the verb. 正在 cannot go at the end.

zh: 孩子们在看电视呢。
py: hái zi men zài kàn diàn shì ne
en: The kids are watching TV.
why: 在 sits before the verb and 呢 stays at the very end. 呢 cannot sit mid-sentence.

zh: 我正在给奶奶打电话呢。
py: wǒ zhèng zài gěi nǎi nai dǎ diàn huà ne
en: I'm on the phone with Grandma right now.
why: 正在 comes before the whole 给奶奶打电话 phrase and 呢 closes the sentence. 给奶奶 stays before the verb.

zh: 我没在看电视。
py: wǒ méi zài kàn diàn shì
en: I'm not watching TV.
why: 没 goes before 在 and both come before the verb. 没 does not go at the end, and 正 is not added.

zh: 小王没在楼下等你。
py: xiǎo wáng méi zài lóu xià děng nǐ
en: Xiao Wang isn't waiting for you downstairs.
why: 没在 comes right after the subject, then the place, then the verb phrase. The place cannot move after the verb.

zh: 他进来的时候，我们正在吃晚饭。
py: tā jìn lái de shí hou wǒ men zhèng zài chī wǎn fàn
en: When he came in, we were having dinner.
why: The 的时候 clause sets the moment and comes first. The main clause then uses 正在 + verb, with no 了.

zh: 昨天晚上八点，爸爸在看电视。
py: zuó tiān wǎn shang bā diǎn bà ba zài kàn diàn shì
en: At eight last night Dad was watching TV.
why: The time phrase can stand before or after the subject, but always before 在. 在 stays directly in front of the verb.

zh: 明天这个时候，我可能正在机场等朋友。
py: míng tiān zhè ge shí hou wǒ kě néng zhèng zài jī chǎng děng péng you
en: This time tomorrow I'll probably be at the airport waiting for a friend.
why: 正在 has no tense, so the future moment is set by the time phrase. 正在 + place + verb stays in this order.

zh: 哥哥一直在等朋友。
py: gē ge yī zhí zài děng péng you
en: My older brother has been waiting for his friend all along.
why: 一直 comes before 在 and the verb phrase follows. With 一直 the marker is plain 在.

zh: 妈妈正在厨房做饭。
py: mā ma zhèng zài chú fáng zuò fàn
en: Mum is cooking in the kitchen right now.
why: One 正在 serves as both 'in progress' and 'at', so the place follows it directly and the verb comes last.

zh: 李老师不在办公室，她正在教室上课。
py: lǐ lǎo shī bù zài bàn gōng shì tā zhèng zài jiào shì shàng kè
en: Teacher Li isn't in the office, she's teaching in the classroom right now.
why: 不在办公室 uses 在 as a main verb with 不. The second clause uses 正在 + place + verb, with the place before 上课.

zh: 他现在有时间。
py: tā xiàn zài yǒu shí jiān
en: He has time right now.
why: 有 is a state, so the tile 在 is not used. 现在 alone supplies 'right now', and it can go before or after the subject.

zh: 我正在看一本书。
py: wǒ zhèng zài kàn yī běn shū
en: I'm reading a book.
why: After 正在 the verb stays bare, so the tile 了 is not used. 了 would say the book has been read.

zh: 已经半夜了，邻居还在装修。
py: yǐ jīng bàn yè le lín jū hái zài zhuāng xiū
en: It's already midnight and the neighbours are still renovating.
why: 还 comes before 在, and 在 before the verb. 还 shows the activity continues, so plain 在 is used, not 正在.

zh: 妹妹没在洗澡。
py: mèi mei méi zài xǐ zǎo
en: My younger sister isn't taking a shower.
why: In-progress 在 is negated by putting 没 before it. 不 and 没正 are not used.

src_py: hái zi men zhèng zài wán yóu xì
task: Say they are not doing it.
zh: 孩子们没在玩游戏。
py: hái zi men méi zài wán yóu xì
en: The kids aren't playing games.
why: 正 drops out once 没 is added, so 正在 becomes 没在. 没正在 is not a form.

task: Say he is eating it right now, using 正在.
zh: 弟弟正在吃苹果。
py: dì di zhèng zài chī píng guǒ
en: My younger brother is eating an apple right now.
why: 正在 goes between the subject and the verb phrase to mark the action as under way.

src_py: wǒ men děng gōng gòng qì chē
task: Say we are in the middle of doing it, using 在.
zh: 我们在等公共汽车。
py: wǒ men zài děng gōng gòng qì chē
en: We're waiting for the bus.
why: 在 comes straight before the verb phrase. It does not go at the end of the sentence.

task: Add 呢 to say it is going on right now.
zh: 奶奶在做饭呢。
py: nǎi nai zài zuò fàn ne
en: Grandma is cooking.
why: 呢 is added at the very end of the statement and the rest does not change.

task: Say she is on the phone right now, using 正在 and 呢.
zh: 姐姐正在打电话呢。
py: jiě jie zhèng zài dǎ diàn huà ne
en: My older sister is on the phone right now.
why: 正在 goes before the verb phrase and 呢 closes the sentence. The two can appear together.

src: 他回家的时候，妈妈做饭了。
src_py: tā huí jiā de shí hou mā ma zuò fàn le
task: Say Mum was in the middle of cooking, using 正在.
zh: 他回家的时候，妈妈正在做饭。
py: tā huí jiā de shí hou mā ma zhèng zài zuò fàn
en: When he got home, Mum was cooking.
why: 'Was in the middle of' needs 正在 and a bare verb, and the 了 of the source sentence has to go.

src_py: wǒ zài děng nǐ bàn ge xiǎo shí
task: Fix it: say you have been waiting for half an hour.
zh: 我等了你半个小时了。
py: wǒ děng le nǐ bàn ge xiǎo shí le
en: I've been waiting for you for half an hour.
why: 在 cannot take a duration. 'Have been doing for X' is verb + 了 + duration + 了.

src_py: mèi mei zài wán shǒu jī
task: Say she is still doing it, using 还.
zh: 妹妹还在玩手机。
py: mèi mei hái zài wán shǒu jī
en: My younger sister is still playing on her phone.
why: 还 goes before 在 and keeps plain 在, because the activity is continuing.

src_py: wǒ kàn shū zài tú shū guǎn
zh: 我在图书馆看书。
py: wǒ zài tú shū guǎn kàn shū
en: I'm reading in the library.
why: The place phrase with 在 goes before the verb, not after the object. The place can also open the sentence.

s: 弟弟是写作业。
s_py: dì di shì xiě zuò yè
zh: 弟弟在写作业。
py: dì di zài xiě zuò yè
en: My younger brother is doing his homework.
why: 'Is doing' is 在 before the verb. 是 does not translate English 'is' here.

s: 爷爷看报纸在。
s_py: yé ye kàn bào zhǐ zài
zh: 爷爷在看报纸。
py: yé ye zài kàn bào zhǐ
en: Grandpa is reading the newspaper.
why: 在 goes before the verb, never at the end of the sentence.

s: 爸爸睡觉呢，你小声一点儿。
s_py: bà ba shuì jiào ne nǐ xiǎo shēng yī diǎn r
zh: 爸爸睡觉呢，你小声一点儿。
py: bà ba shuì jiào ne nǐ xiǎo shēng yī diǎn r
en: Dad is sleeping, keep your voice down.
why: Final 呢 alone can mark an action in progress, so no 在 is needed. The sentence is correct.

s: 妈妈不正在做饭。
s_py: mā ma bù zhèng zài zuò fàn
zh: 妈妈没在做饭。
py: mā ma méi zài zuò fàn
en: Mum isn't cooking.
why: An action in progress is negated with 没, and 正 drops out. 不正在 does not exist.

s: 我在喜欢这只小狗。
s_py: wǒ zài xǐ huan zhè zhī xiǎo gǒu
zh: 我喜欢这只小狗。
py: wǒ xǐ huan zhè zhī xiǎo gǒu
en: I like this puppy.
why: 喜欢 is a state and cannot take 在. English '-ing' is no reason to add it.

s: 他没在睡觉，他在玩手机。
s_py: tā méi zài shuì jiào tā zài wán shǒu jī
zh: 他没在睡觉，他在玩手机。
py: tā méi zài shuì jiào tā zài wán shǒu jī
en: He isn't sleeping, he's on his phone.
why: 没在 denies the first action and plain 在 states the second. This is correct.

s: 奶奶不在房间，她在院子里。
s_py: nǎi nai bù zài fáng jiān tā zài yuàn zi lǐ
zh: 奶奶不在房间，她在院子里。
py: nǎi nai bù zài fáng jiān tā zài yuàn zi lǐ
en: Grandma isn't in the room, she's in the yard.
why: 在 as a main verb is negated with 不, so 不在房间 is correct. It is not the progressive.

s: 他进来的时候，我们正在吃了晚饭。
s_py: tā jìn lái de shí hou wǒ men zhèng zài chī le wǎn fàn
zh: 他进来的时候，我们正在吃晚饭。
py: tā jìn lái de shí hou wǒ men zhèng zài chī wǎn fàn
en: When he came in, we were having dinner.
why: 正在 says the meal was not finished and 了 says it was, so they cannot share one verb. The verb stays bare.

s: 你昨天打电话的时候，我正在路上开车。
s_py: nǐ zuó tiān dǎ diàn huà de shí hou wǒ zhèng zài lù shang kāi chē
zh: 你昨天打电话的时候，我正在路上开车。
py: nǐ zuó tiān dǎ diàn huà de shí hou wǒ zhèng zài lù shang kāi chē
en: When you called yesterday I was driving on the road.
why: 正在 works with 昨天 because it has no tense. This is correct.

s: 爷爷一直正在看新闻。
s_py: yé ye yī zhí zhèng zài kàn xīn wén
zh: 爷爷一直在看新闻。
py: yé ye yī zhí zài kàn xīn wén
en: Grandpa has been watching the news the whole time.
why: 一直 spreads the activity over time, which clashes with 正在 pointing at one moment. Use plain 在.

s: 孩子们踢足球在公园里。
s_py: hái zi men tī zú qiú zài gōng yuán lǐ
zh: 孩子们在公园里踢足球。
py: hái zi men zài gōng yuán lǐ tī zú qiú
en: The kids are playing football in the park.
why: The 在 place phrase must come before the verb, not after the object.

s: 他不在家，他在公司加班。
s_py: tā bù zài jiā tā zài gōng sī jiā bān
zh: 他不在家，他在公司加班。
py: tā bù zài jiā tā zài gōng sī jiā bān
en: He isn't at home, he's working overtime at the office.
why: 不在家 uses 在 as a main verb, and 在公司加班 uses 在 as a place marker. Both are correct.

s: 我们在吃完晚饭。
s_py: wǒ men zài chī wán wǎn fàn
zh: 我们在吃晚饭。
py: wǒ men zài chī wǎn fàn
en: We are having dinner.
why: A result complement like 完 means finished, which contradicts in-progress 在. The verb stays bare.

s: 你小声点，弟弟正在在客厅里写作业，他明天要考试。
s_py: nǐ xiǎo shēng diǎn dì di zhèng zài zài kè tīng lǐ xiě zuò yè tā míng tiān yào kǎo shì
zh: 你小声点，弟弟正在客厅里写作业，他明天要考试。
py: nǐ xiǎo shēng diǎn dì di zhèng zài kè tīng lǐ xiě zuò yè tā míng tiān yào kǎo shì
en: Keep it down, my younger brother is doing homework in the living room, he has an exam tomorrow.
why: One 在 does double duty as 'in progress' and 'at'. A doubled 正在在 is never said.

s: 小猫还在沙发上睡觉呢。
s_py: xiǎo māo hái zài shā fā shàng shuì jiào ne
zh: 小猫还在沙发上睡觉呢。
py: xiǎo māo hái zài shā fā shàng shuì jiào ne
en: The kitten is still asleep on the sofa.
why: 还 plus plain 在 plus final 呢 is a normal combination. The sentence is correct.

s: 我在写作业两个小时了。
s_py: wǒ zài xiě zuò yè liǎng ge xiǎo shí le
zh: 我写了两个小时的作业了。
py: wǒ xiě le liǎng ge xiǎo shí de zuò yè le
en: I've been doing homework for two hours.
why: 在 cannot take a duration. 'Have been doing for two hours' is verb + 了 + duration + 的 + object + 了.

s: 他已经在睡觉了，我们明天再给他打电话吧。
s_py: tā yǐ jīng zài shuì jiào le wǒ men míng tiān zài gěi tā dǎ diàn huà ba
zh: 他已经在睡觉了，我们明天再给他打电话吧。
py: tā yǐ jīng zài shuì jiào le wǒ men míng tiān zài gěi tā dǎ diàn huà ba
en: He is already asleep, let's call him tomorrow.
why: 已经在 + verb + 了 is correct and means 'is already at it'. The 了 belongs to the whole sentence.

s: 妈妈正在打扫过房间，你别进去。
s_py: mā ma zhèng zài dǎ sǎo guo fáng jiān nǐ bié jìn qù
zh: 妈妈正在打扫房间，你别进去。
py: mā ma zhèng zài dǎ sǎo fáng jiān nǐ bié jìn qù
en: Mum is cleaning the room, don't go in.
why: 正在 means the cleaning is under way, while 过 says it was done before. They cannot share a verb.

s: 我没有在看手机，我在看地图上的路线。
s_py: wǒ méi yǒu zài kàn shǒu jī wǒ zài kàn dì tú shàng de lù xiàn
zh: 我没有在看手机，我在看地图上的路线。
py: wǒ méi yǒu zài kàn shǒu jī wǒ zài kàn dì tú shàng de lù xiàn
en: I'm not looking at my phone, I'm looking at the route on the map.
why: 没有在 is the full form of 没在 and correctly denies the first action. The sentence is correct.

s: 你为什么没正在听我说话？
s_py: nǐ wèi shén me méi zhèng zài tīng wǒ shuō huà
zh: 你为什么没在听我说话？
py: nǐ wèi shén me méi zài tīng wǒ shuō huà
en: Why aren't you listening to me?
why: 正 drops out after 没, so the form is 没在. 没正在 does not exist.
